text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan holds behind-doors meeting with Italian President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro.

- King Hassan, in interview with Italian TV channel RAI UNO, says of Western Sahara and U.N. peace plan: "The engine has broken down, I hope the United Nations new secretary- general is a better mechanic."
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali presides over interministerial meeting on reform of transport sector which will include review of taxation.
- Marrakesh hosts two-day international water seminar on rational use of water.
- King Hassan and Italian President Scalfaro to inaugurate Morocco's biggest dam Al Wahda.
- King Hassan tells Italian TV "convention signed between government and political parties to guarantee transparency of polls shows extent of consensus and political maturity."
- Washington welcomes nomination of former State Department Secretary James Baker as U.N. special envoy in Western Sahara.
- Government to amend law on transport sector after workers threatened to stage strike.

- Impact of last year liberalisation of wheat, sugar and edible oil raises worries of agriculture sector ahead of a World Bank report on development strategy in rural regions to be released in Rabat before end of April.
